facts_of_case: The applicant-wife seeks transfer of petition under Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 from Family Court Jhajjar to Rupnagar. She claims her husband kidnapped their children and is demanding a sum for giving divorce.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot keep a person in the dark about their earlier marriage.
legal_principles.held: The respondent came to know about the factum of the earlier marriage of the applicant only when he could lay his hands on the documents, relating to the litigation pending between the applicant and her previous husband, Supinder Singh, while she was away from the matrimonial house.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot continue with litigation against another person while being in a new relationship.
legal_principles.held: The applicant continued with the litigation with her previous husband, Supinder Singh, without seeking divorce from him and at the same time performed second marriage with the present respondent.

outcome.final_order: The present application is allowed and the requisite list is taken on record.
